Variants.Content: Dragonstone is a volcanic island where the heat of the Dragonmont, sulfurous fumes, black rock strata, and underground veins of dragonglass form a singular environment. The Targaryen forebears raised the fortress of Dragonstone here, shaping stone dragons, smoke-like towers, and organic curves with Valyrian craft so that the castle seems to grow straight out of the volcanic rock. Thin soil limits farming, leaving island life reliant on fishing, scant tillage, and sea-borne provisions, while its volcanic harbor and position in Blackwater Bay give it strategic weight far beyond its size. The earth's heat may be seen as the lingering warmth of the dragonlords' homeland, or simply as a reminder to the islanders that the ground beneath their feet has never truly fallen quiet.

The islanders know the smell of brimstone, black stone, and warm fissures as everyday things that only outsiders marvel at. They care more about the harvest from thin soil and whether supply ships arrive in season.

Those of Valyrian blood easily see symbols of dragons and lineage in the volcano, while scholars study the rock strata and dragonglass. However one explains it, the shapes of Dragonstone make every visitor feel that the place obeys another memory of building altogether.

Powers around Blackwater Bay view Dragonstone more practically: it commands the sea approach, and requires steady shipments of grain. The volcano makes the castle grim; sea transport is what lets a garrison hold it over time.
